description:
Get restatement ledger for a statement identity

Return the restatement ledger for a given (cik, statement_type, fiscal_year, fiscal_period) identity.

Each hop compares two filings that report the statement, in SEC acceptance order; each filing appears once. A filing whose figures match the filing before it, such as an amendment that leaves this statement untouched, is merged into the run it repeats unless `include_unchanged_filings=true`, so by default every hop reflects a change in reported figures.

Each hop names its two filings in `from_version` and `to_version` by SEC accession; pass the accessions to the restatement delta as `from_accession` and `to_accession` to compare exactly that hop.

cik.description: Company CIK as digits (for example 0000320193). Send this or `ticker`, not both.

fiscal_period.description: Fiscal period code (e.g., FY, Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4).

fiscal_year.description: Fiscal year for the ledger identity.

include_unchanged_filings.description: Include filings that repeated the figures served before them. By default the ledger hops from the first report to each filing that restated the period, so every hop is a change in what it serves.

statement_date.description: End date of the statement's period (YYYY-MM-DD). Names the period to compare when the identity reports more than one: a fiscal year split at a business combination or fresh-start reorganization is reported as two OTHER periods, and each is compared across filings on its own. Without it the comparison covers the later period. A date that names no period of the identity answers 404, listing the dates in `details.available_statement_dates`.

ticker.description: Ticker symbol naming the company, in place of `cik`; send one or the other. Resolves to the company whose filings hold its statements as of the request's as-of or period-end date, or as of today when the request has none.

name: edgar_statements_restatements_ledger
